query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.rating=1 THEN LENGTH(r.body) ELSE 0 END)-AVG(CASE WHEN r.rating=5 THEN LENGTH(r.body) ELSE 0 END),1) FROM reviews r JOIN products p USING(category,ref_id) WHERE p.category='electronics' AND r.verified=1 AND r.body>''
columns: ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.rating=1 THEN LENGTH(r.body) ELSE 0 END)-AVG(CASE WHEN r.rating=5 THEN LENGTH(r.body) ELSE 0 END),1)
